description:
Egan's are delighted to present no.94 Derrygreenagh Park to open market for sale. The property is a two bay, two-storey mid-terraced house and comprises of an entrance hall, living room, kitchen/dining room and bathroom on the ground floor, and a further three bedrooms on the first floor. There is large secure garden to the rear of the property, and has the benefit of having rear access via a shared laneway.

Derrygreenagh is a unique estate of former worker's houses who were employed in Derrygreenagh works on the Westmeath/Offaly border to the south. Derrygreenagh was built in the mid-1950s by Bord na Móna, following the Turf Development Act. The estate is formed on a circular plan around a quiet and mature green with 100 houses in total, and a three-storey community centre in the middle. Derrygreenagh is an important addition to the architectural heritage of the twentieth century in Ireland and is an interesting addition to the built heritage of Co. Westmeath. Rochfortbridge is a busy village on the southern fringes of the Westmeath/Offaly border, it is accessible via the M6 motorway serving Dublin - Galway, Dublin in just under an hour away. There is a primary school and St. Joseph's secondary school, and all local amenities that come with village living. Mullingar (approx. 15km away) is the main county town of Westmeath, with a bustling nightlife & music scene, and for anglers, there are three large neighbouring lakes, Lough Owel, Lough Ennell & Lough Deravarragh.

Viewing of this property, is highly recommended with Egan's.
